witness.candidate_quote: Any motor vehicle may be equipped with one or more backup lamps either separately or in combination with other lamps.
witness.quote: Any motor vehicle may be equipped with one or more backup lamps either separately or in combination with other lamps. Backup lamps shall not be lighted when the vehicle is in forward motion.
witness.reason: Intersection travel supports a forward-motion interval with optional backup lamps; the other vehicle's mere presence supplies no activation evidence.
required_context: Construct the intersection route and a separate other vehicle's position, motion, priority and purpose.
Establish qualifying motor-vehicle classification and installed backup-lamp inventory.
Retain actual forward-motion intervals with synchronized heading, velocity, speed and lamp illumination.
witness.review_method: Agent review of exact law, fixed layout/maneuver/control, actor scope and retained conditional context
